therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Older adults with late-life depression and cognitive impairment
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Global Cognitive Performance, Cognitive IADL, Recurrence of Major Depression

results.effect_size: HR = 3.97 (95% CI: 1.00–4.41) for depression recurrence; Global cognition Z-score donepezil -0.31 vs placebo -0.56 at Year 2
subgroup_findings: Participants with MCI converting to dementia: 10% donepezil vs 33% placebo (post-hoc)
Global cognition at Year 1: donepezil -0.23 vs placebo -0.65
Global cognition at Year 2: donepezil -0.31 vs placebo -0.56
Cognitive IADL independent functioning at Year 2: donepezil 36.67% vs placebo 47.22%
Depression recurrence: donepezil 19 participants vs placebo 11 participants (HR=3.97, p=0.05)
safety_signals: Myocardial infarction with congestive heart failure in donepezil arm (1/67)
Death due to heart attack in placebo arm (1/63)

dose_info.dose: Donepezil 5–10 mg; Escitalopram 10–20 mg; Venlafaxine 150–300 mg

adverse_events.term: Myocardial infarction with congestive heart failure

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Donepezil co-administration with antidepressant was associated with higher depression recurrence rates (HR=3.97), suggesting cholinergic enhancement may negatively modulate antidepressant-mediated mood stabilization biology
